name: Alistair MacLeod
bio:
Alistair's journey into motorsport PR started unconventionally, with a degree in film studies and a passion for documentary filmmaking. He initially focused on creating short films about local racing events, quickly realizing the power of storytelling in shaping public perception. This led him to pursue opportunities in motorsport media and communications. He cut his teeth at a smaller racing team, before landing a role at Team WRT.

Alistair believes in crafting compelling narratives that go beyond the track, highlighting the human element behind the machines. He focuses on building strong relationships with media outlets and leveraging digital platforms to engage fans directly. His strength lies in his ability to translate complex technical details into accessible and exciting content for a wider audience. He is known for his innovative approach to PR, always seeking new ways to connect with fans and sponsors.

He brings a unique blend of creative vision and strategic thinking to Team WRT's PR efforts. Alistair is committed to elevating the team's brand and ensuring its story resonates with audiences globally, making him a valuable asset to the team.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly styled with a slight side parting.
physical.description: Alistair is a lean man of average height, with a friendly face and an intense gaze.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with story ideas.
Has a habit of pacing while on phone calls.
Insists on starting every meeting with a short brainstorming session.
